events.title: TII tunes Falcon-Emirati-7B for Emirati dialect and culture
events.title_zh: TII 发布面向阿联酋方言与文化的 Falcon-Emirati-7B
events.summary: TII introduced Falcon-Emirati-7B, a regional Arabic model built on Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B with authentic Emirati web data, Modern Standard Arabic cultural material and constrained synthetic data. TII reports 84.83% on Alyah and stronger dialect fidelity than tested alternatives. A public chat is available, but weights, code and an API were not available at review time.
events.summary_zh: TII 发布 Falcon-Emirati-7B。模型基于 Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B，训练材料包括真实的阿联酋网络文本、现代标准阿拉伯语文化材料和受约束的合成数据。TII 报告其在 Alyah 上达到 84.83%，方言贴合度也高于所比较的模型。公开聊天入口已上线，但复核时没有公开权重、代码或 API。
events.why_it_matters: For Arabic-language product teams, this is a concrete signal that regional dialect and cultural evaluation need dedicated models and tests. The closed artifact prevents independent deployment and benchmark verification for now.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对阿拉伯语产品团队来说，这说明地区方言与文化能力需要专门的模型和评测。当前产物仍封闭，暂时无法独立部署，也难以复核厂商 benchmark。

technical_details.training_data: authentic Emirati web text, MSA cultural material and constrained synthetic data
technical_details.reported_dialect_fidelity: 0.52 using Gemini 3.7 Flash as judge; alternatives reported at 0.05 or lower
technical_details.availability: public chat only; no public weights, code or API found

technical_details_zh.基础模型: Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B，混合 Mamba 与注意力机制
technical_details_zh.训练数据: 真实阿联酋网络文本、现代标准阿拉伯语文化材料和受约束的合成数据
technical_details_zh.报告的_Alyah: 1,173 道母语者编写选择题上为 84.83%
technical_details_zh.报告的方言贴合度: 以 Gemini 3.7 Flash 作 judge 得分 0.52；对比模型最高 0.05
technical_details_zh.可用性: 仅公开聊天；未发现公开权重、代码或 API

events.next_action_zh: 等权重或 API 开放后，用真实阿联酋客服语料复测方言理解、文化常识和标准阿拉伯语回退。
events.next_action_en: Reassess when weights or an API open, using real Emirati support data to test dialect understanding, cultural knowledge and MSA fallback.
events.summary_en: TII introduced Falcon-Emirati-7B, a regional Arabic model built on Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B with authentic Emirati web data, Modern Standard Arabic cultural material and constrained synthetic data. TII reports 84.83% on Alyah and stronger dialect fidelity than tested alternatives. A public chat is available, but weights, code and an API were not available at review time.
events.why_it_matters_en: For Arabic-language product teams, this is a concrete signal that regional dialect and cultural evaluation need dedicated models and tests. The closed artifact prevents independent deployment and benchmark verification for now.

evidence.claim_en: TII introduced Falcon-Emirati-7B, a regional Arabic model built on Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B with authentic Emirati web data, Modern Standard Arabic cultural material and constrained synthetic data.

events.title: Mistral previews Large 4 with a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE
events.title_zh: Mistral 预览 1T 参数多模态 MoE 模型 Large 4
events.summary: Mistral opened a public preview API for Large 4, a natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 1.05T total parameters, 49B active parameters and a 1.6B vision encoder. The model combines instruction following, reasoning and agentic capabilities and supports more than 160 languages. Weights and fuller architecture and post-training details are promised by the end of October.
events.summary_zh: Mistral 开放 Large 4 的 public preview API。它是原生多模态 MoE 模型，总参数 1.05T、激活参数 49B，并带 1.6B 参数视觉编码器。模型统一指令跟随、推理和 agent 能力，支持 160 多种语言。权重、更完整的架构与后训练细节计划在 10 月底前发布。
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating sovereign or self-hosted frontier models, Large 4 provides an API-visible target now and promises weights shortly. Treat it as a trial until the weights, license terms, full benchmarks and serving requirements can be checked.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估主权部署或自托管前沿模型的团队来说，Large 4 已有可调用 API，并承诺很快发布权重。在权重、许可、完整 benchmark 和服务资源需求可核查前，应先按 TRIAL 处理。

technical_details.architecture: granular MoE; 1.05T total and 49B active parameters; 1.6B vision encoder
technical_details.availability: public preview API in Mistral Studio
technical_details.capabilities: native multimodal input; unified instruction, reasoning and agentic behavior; 160+ languages
technical_details.evidence_limit: full architecture, additional benchmarks and post-training details not yet published

technical_details_zh.架构: 细粒度 MoE；总参数 1.05T、激活参数 49B；1.6B 视觉编码器
technical_details_zh.权重: 承诺在 2026 年 10 月底前发布
technical_details_zh.能力: 原生多模态输入；统一指令、推理与 agent 行为；支持 160 多种语言
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 完整架构、更多 benchmark 与后训练细节尚未发布

events.next_action_zh: 一天内通过 preview API 跑多模态工具调用、长上下文和 160+ 语言中的目标语种测试，并记录延迟、成本与失败恢复。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, use the preview API to test multimodal tool use, long context and target languages, recording latency, cost and recovery failures.
